note: Illustrative alerts shaped like a typical enterprise crisis-alerting feed (Everbridge, Dataminr, Crisis24, Resilinc, Interos and similar). They are invented for the scenario: never present them as real news. The enterprise system alerts offices, sites, suppliers and travellers; ClinRadar works out which alerts touch our studies, sites, routes and facilities.

alerts.title: Belgium: national action day on 24 Nov 2026, Brussels Airport expects no departures
alerts.summary: Unions have called a national action day for Tuesday 24 November. Brussels Airport expects no departing flights; disruption is likely on public transport and at ports. Staff should plan to work from home.

alerts.title: United States: heavy snow and ice in eastern Pennsylvania, 16 to 17 Nov 2026
alerts.summary: A winter storm is forecast for eastern Pennsylvania, including Allentown and the Lehigh Valley. Expect slow roads and possible office closures.

alerts.title: Seasonal outlook for Andalusia (Sevilla, Málaga): above-normal temperatures in March 2027
alerts.summary: The seasonal climate outlook gives above-normal temperatures for Andalusia through March 2027, with early heat episodes possible. Review temperature-sensitive deliveries and outdoor work.

alerts.title: Netherlands: ransomware outage at NorthSea Freight Systems, tracking and bookings down
alerts.summary: NorthSea Freight Systems, a freight forwarder used by some business units, reports a ransomware incident. Its tracking and booking platform is offline while it restores systems.

alerts.title: Taiwan: typhoon warning for the north of the island, 17 to 18 Nov 2026
alerts.summary: A typhoon warning is in force for northern Taiwan, including Taipei. Offices may close and flights from Taoyuan are likely to be cancelled.

alerts.title: France: demonstration in central Paris on 21 Nov 2026, road closures around Place de la République
alerts.summary: A large demonstration is announced for Saturday 21 November in central Paris. Expect road closures and metro station closures around Place de la République and Nation.

alerts.title: Switzerland: planned power interruption in the Basel industrial area, 19 Nov 2026, 08:00 to 14:00
alerts.summary: The grid operator has announced a planned power interruption for the Kleinhüningen and Klybeck industrial areas of Basel on Thursday 19 November, 08:00 to 14:00. Sites without backup power should plan for it.
